name: Midweek - Ethel Creek
description:
Midweek Hike - Thu, 17th August 

Leader: Cherry Judge

Rated: On-Track hike. For the easy to moderately fit walkers who can walk about 3=4 hrs with a break 
 
Walk Description:
We will begin in Paluma village, making our way to Cloudy Creek.
Once we reach Cloudy Creek, we will cross the creek and then continue along a 'less traveled' track to Ethel Creek Falls.
We stop for morning tea and a swim at Ethel creek Falls.
Then we come back the same way
 After the walk, if anyone is keen we can head to the cafe in Paluma for a post walk coffee

name: Cascades / Terraces - FULL
description:
**This walk is has now reached capacity**

Sun, 6th August, 2023
The Terraces and High Camp, Palm Creek
Leader: Keith Dyson

Rated - Off Track, moderately hard. 

Terrain - Creek based and cross country, rough terrain. Rock hopping, boulder scrambles, rockface traverses, scrub and vines, uneven footing, slippery rocks, steep climbs.

Distance: 11 km, elevation change 300m

Description:
A club classic walk, up Palm Creek (St Margaret's Creek system) to the Terraces, Ultima Falls, Garden Wall, and High Camp.
A creek-based walk with many waterfalls, one of the most scenic creeks in the region (and the state) and one of the local gems.
The club had been bushwalking St Margaret's Creek system since 1966 !

On way out, includes a stop at the at the Rockslides for a swim, then the walk back to the cars.

And most important, ice creams at the roadhouse on the way home to finish the day off.

A good day out for our adventurous bushwalkers.

What you need: carry water (minimum 2 lt), refill from creek as required (treat / filter your water refill) . Lunch, snacks / energy food, electrolytes, hat, sunscreen, insect repellent, enclosed sturdy footwear. Recommend long sleeve clothing / gaiters to avoid scratches. Some members also wear fingerless gloves.
Time and Meet:
Meet 07:30 at the Alligator Creek Caltex roadhouse - junction Bentley Drive / Bruce Hwy, Alligator Creek. We will be carpooling from there. This is a full day hike, we expect to be back at the cars by 5 pm 
RSVP for the Terraces 
Must be over 18yrs to participate Or accepted by committee.

Fee: non-members/visitors/- $5 . TBWC Club members - Free.
You can become a TBWC member after 3 walks as a visitor.

If you are a new walker/non-member who has not walked with us before – please contact the walk leader before RSVP registration.
